title: Availability Check Request v2
description: Read/check request for an exact approved sell/trade-item finished-goods UOM. The provider must validate the case-sensitive UOM as ACTIVE and must not convert or aggregate mixed UOMs.
$comment: OWNER-DIRECTIVE-2026-09-03-EXT-OD-01-07 / EXT-OD-03. requested_quantity is optional numeric(18,3) and strictly greater than zero. Omission means an availability-existence check. warehouse_id omission means ALL warehouse scope; a supplied ID means exact WAREHOUSE scope with no fallback.

batch_id.description: Optional exact batch UUID; no cross-batch fallback is allowed when supplied.

warehouse_id.description: Optional exact accessible ACTIVE warehouse UUID. Omission selects ALL warehouse scope. Malformed UUID is 422; missing, inactive, or inaccessible is 404.

uom_code.description: Required case-sensitive ACTIVE approved sell/trade-item finished-goods UOM code. No case folding, conversion, or mixed-UOM aggregation is allowed.

requested_quantity.description: Optional positive decimal string with numeric(18,3) precision. When present, the result is full-fill only.
